description: Note rates on HUD Section 232 loans at closing from HUD's fiscal-year closings file (count, median and middle half, by program, and month by month for 223(f)), plus the number of loans HUD endorsed each fiscal year since 2016 for the program. Historical rates, not a quote.

by_month.description: For 223f, include the month-by-month note rates (months with 3 or more loans).

program.description: Default 223f. 223f (refinance or purchase), 223a7 (streamlined refinance of an FHA loan), new-construction (new construction or substantial rehab) or 241a (supplemental loan).

name: get_closing_stats
title: HUD 232 closing rates and volumes
